timing_aggregation: median of five executions; preprocessing and search separated; final decoding included; offline training excluded
f1_aggregation: per-task F1 then domain mean then equally weighted domain macro
common_score_final_decoder: same fresh deterministic decoder for every common-score method; once at completion for ordinary methods, each improved output checkpoint for Alternating-Time

gold_schema_reference.missing_column_pairs: add compatibility vectors with unchanged frozen scorer on original E

column_coverage_denominator: non-null gold column pairs across four tasks per domain per ambiguity level; null excluded

alternating_restarts.later: maximize S minus mean fraction of role agreements with previous starts, including null; exclude previous starts
alternating_restarts.selection: largest original joint endpoint objective; earlier endpoint wins ties
alternating_restarts.cache: shared, solver state reset per restart

alternating_time.budget: per-task median FuseMap search time over five completed executions including final decoding
alternating_time.output: best fully converged restart endpoint checkpoint whose common fresh decoding finishes before deadline
alternating_time.charged: start generation, updates, incomplete work, every checkpoint decode
alternating_time.deadline: cancel outstanding work; return previous complete checkpoint
alternating_time.f1: average timed trials within each task, then tasks within domain, then equally weighted domains
alternating_time.completed_runs: median trials per task then median tasks per domain
alternating_time.first_checkpoint: completes within budget in all primary tasks
alternating_time.scope: descriptive experimental protocol; wall-clock execution not implemented by the small reference
